frame_row: CVA6 RV32 tile with width adapters to the unchanged 64-bit/52-bit cluster interfaces.

label: u_dont_touch_cva6
(cva6, RV32 config)
blocks.function: CVA6 core built from the RV32 configuration package: 32-bit integer datapath, Sv32 MMU, 34-bit physical address, HPDcache write-back with 32-bit words.

label: line_addr_adapter
(30-bit to 52-bit)
blocks.function: Zero-extend every cache-line address leaving the core to the 52-bit cluster width and drop the upper 22 bits of every line address entering it; assert they are zero.

label: vaddr_adapter
(32-bit to 64-bit)
blocks.function: Pass the low 32 bits of the boot address and hart identity into the core and zero-extend the CMO virtual address and PC outputs to 64 bits.

label: axi_record_slicer
(unchanged, 64-bit AXI)
blocks.function: Slice the CVA6 AXI request record into flat AXI ports; unchanged because AXI data and address stay 64-bit and the user field stays 64-bit.

label: region_decode
(unchanged)
blocks.function: Classify each AW and AR window with the shared region table; table entries must lie below 2^34.
